title: Nice Cups!
text: Nice Cups!. I like using insulated cups with straws for my daily water intake. These cups are clear so you can easily see how much water you have left. They are durable. Two of them have pastel lids and straws and the third one is just all translucent. I would prefer if it had also been a color instead. They work well at keeping the drinks chilled for a while.
